implementation.numeric_dependency: Python standard-library decimal only; no NumPy or EDA dependency
implementation.algorithm: Connected positive resistor graph -> grounded symmetric Laplacian -> Decimal LDL transpose factorization with strictly positive pivots -> triangular solves.
implementation.reference: The first contact in the authenticated original contact list is a voltage gauge only; other non-injected contacts have zero external current and are not clamped.
implementation.injections: For each network, 7 complete reference-contact unit injections plus all 28 unordered contact-pair +1 A/-1 A injections.
implementation.complete_results: Every solved case emits all 102 node voltages and all 145 original resistor rows with signed a-to-b current, a-minus-b voltage and nonnegative edge power. Full 8x8 contact impedance and effective resistance matrices and original target/114 capacitor rows are preserved.
checks: Complete R-connectivity; unique exact native-to-loaded node/element/contact identities and component joins
Each node's current balance versus the explicit injected current
Sum of all I^2R dissipation equals injected terminal power
Symmetry of independently solved multi-terminal contact impedance
Each directly solved pair agrees with Zii+Zjj-Zij-Zji
Finite Decimal values, strictly positive R/pivots and positive effective pair resistance
implementation.numerical_residual_policy: Absolute 1e-40 plus relative 1e-40 at Decimal precision 80. This is only a numerical consistency criterion; no original electrical gate or device limit is changed.
implementation.capacitors: All original capacitor rows retained. They are omitted from the conductance matrix only for the DC open-circuit model; this does not justify omission from the actual transient.

source_integrity.new_source_pin_requirement: Root workflow must externally pin exact reader/checker/config bytes and current source before running.

analytic_cases: 2+3 ohm series with all edge currents and power
Unbalanced bridge analytic delta-star R=155/74 ohm and cross-edge current=1/37 A
DC capacitor omission with full row retention
refusals: Duplicate/unknown/aliased nodes/contacts/elements; wrong partition and disconnected graph
Negative/unrelated capacitors; corrupted/missing/nonfinite voltages; KCL/gauge/injection failures
Wrong authentic composition/net/acceptance and context/path/evidence/configuration bytes
hosted_controls.lifecycle: Actual run/finalization/encoder paths with explicit small synthetic networks only: complete byte-chunk roundtrip, partial results, primary plus final-save error, source plus emit error, output collision.

caller.strict_environment: GitHub Actions hosted Linux, manual workflow_dispatch, attempt 1, exact repository/branch/current SHA
caller.publication: Preserve the full output directory plus complete stdout/stderr and job log; chunks contain every output byte. No direct empty asset upload is required.
caller.reservation: No archive/native acquisition occurs in this unit. Root owns any exact-source output release reservation/publication policy.

limitations: DC unit responses are a linear passive-network characterization, not actual transistor currents or transient contact voltages.
No geometric bridge/access/via resistance attribution follows merely from high edge power or effective contact resistance.
No guaranteed VCE recovery, causal repair, timing, physical or full-PHY acceptance.
Numerical correctness and actual current results still require hosted execution of the authored controls and reader.
